teams.support: Support, tier 1: questions a help-desk agent answers from existing documentation without opening the customer's account. How do I, where do I, how long does something normally take, what are the limits, how to get or activate a card, what to do about a forgotten passcode. The default when neither of the other two teams applies.
teams.technical: Technical, tier 2: something has gone wrong for this customer and someone must investigate their specific account, card, device or transaction. Declined, failed, blocked, not received, not showing up, charged twice, unrecognised transaction, lost or stolen, card never arrived. Takes precedence over support when the customer's own account must be examined.
teams.sales_billing: Sales and billing: money the company charges or products it offers. Fees, exchange rates, an unexpected charge or fee on a statement, pricing, which currencies and countries are supported, eligibility and age limits, closing the account. Takes precedence over the other teams whenever money or eligibility is the subject.
